hits.name: Ritu Sharma
hits.about_user: Ritu Sharma launched her real estate career in 2023 and has quickly built a reputation as a reliable consultant in Dubai’s competitive property market. As a representative of K U N Real Estate, she focuses primarily on off-plan properties, including both apartments and villas, while also managing selected secondary market transactions. With a solid grasp of market trends, project pipelines, and investment strategies, Ritu delivers clear, data-driven guidance that helps clients optimize returns while mitigating risk. His client-centric approach is rooted in transparency, professionalism, and a commitment to long-term relationships. Whether supporting investors in identifying high-yield opportunities or assisting end-users in finding their ideal home, Ritu consistently strives to provide exceptional service and value throughout every stage of the real estate journey.
